title: Relative pseudo-coherence of a derived complex
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a locally finite type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions] and $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. For an integer $m$, say that $E$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent relative to $S$ if there exist an affine open cover $S=\bigcup V_a$, affine open covers $f^{-1}(V_a)=\bigcup U_{ab}$, and closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] $i_{ab}:U_{ab}\hookrightarrow\mathbf A^{n_{ab}}_{V_a}$ over $V_a$ (where $n_{ab}\geq0$ and relative affine space is as in [def-nagata-relative-affine-space]), such that $R(i_{ab})_*(E|_{U_{ab}})$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent [def-sfb-m-pseudo-coherent-complex] on $\mathbf A^{n_{ab}}_{V_a}$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Say $E$ is pseudo-coherent relative to $S$ if it is $m$-pseudo-coherent relative to $S$ for every integer $m$. The covers and embeddings may depend on $m$.
